results.content:
3 min read time  
Topics  
Centific
#### Former Granite Asia Partner to Lead Centific's Next Phase of Growth as a Global Data and AI Solutions Provider.  
Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion.  
Chuen Hong joins Centific from Granite Asia, where he served as a Partner, leading the firm's partnerships ecosystem and special strategic projects. This gave him broad visibility into the AI ecosystem and the dynamics shaping the sector.  
“Chuen Hong is well positioned to lead Centific as we accelerate our ambition to become a leading global data and AI solutions company,” said Tiak Koon Loh, Chairman of the Board of Centific. “The Board is grateful to Venkat and the management team for the strong foundation they have built and is confident that Chuen Hong will carry this momentum into Centific’s next phase of growth.”  
Chuen Hong previously served as Chief Executive of Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), shaping digital technology strategy and AI adoption at a national level. He is a Fellow at Stanford's Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI) and also serves on the International Council for Responsible AI UK.
## About Centific  
Centific (www.centific.com) is a global data and AI solutions company backed by Granite Asia, serving leading AI labs and global enterprises with the human expertise, data infrastructure, and evaluation environments needed to build trusted, resilient AI systems. With more than 3,000 employees and a global expert network of over 2 million contributors spanning 230+ markets through its OneForma platform, Centific partners with organizations at the frontier of AI development.

results.name: Centific appoints Vasudevan Sundarababu as Chief Data and AI Officer
results.content:
Centific, the pioneering frontier AI data foundry, announced the appointment of Vasudevan Sundarababu as its Chief Data and AI Officer.
His significant contributions to Centific’s innovative platforms and AI data solutions have been pivotal to the company’s success, driving substantial advancements and market differentiation. Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, commented, “Vasu’s visionary leadership has been a game-changer for us.
In his enhanced role, Vasu will spearhead the strategic direction of Centific’s data and AI operations, focusing on refining its flagship platforms—Centific Loop, Pitaya, and OneForma—and expanding its influence across global markets.
Reflecting on his new role, Vasu stated, “I am deeply honored by this opportunity to further influence the future of AI and data science at Centific. The landscape is ripe with potential, and I am eager to lead our talented teams to explore new horizons.
This critical appointment comes at a time when Centific continues to stand at the vanguard of AI and data processing innovations. The tech industry is witnessing an unprecedented wave of opportunities for groundbreaking advancements.

# New Year, New CEOs: Big Names Make Bold Moves in 2026  
**Prioritise Us**on Google  
During 2025, Business Chief has been staying up to date with leadership changes across industries from manufacturing and retail to insurance and finance.  
After months of transition planning and firms laying out strategies to introduce the new leaders, the reins are finally being handed to the [next CEOs](https://businesschief.com/news/why-has-bmw-appointed-milan-nedelijkovic-as-its-next-ceo) of some of the world’s biggest companies on 1 January.
## Strengthening GSK’s focus on specialty medicines  
[Luke Miels](https://businesschief.com/news/why-is-gsk-ceo-emma-walmsley-stepping-down-for-luke-miels?utm_source=chatgpt.com) will become CEO of GSK, succeeding [Dame Emma Walmsley,](https://businesschief.com/news/how-has-gsk-faired-under-emma-walmsleys-last-quarter-as-ceo) who has led the company since 2017 and driven major growth in specialty medicines.  
In September, at the time of her resignation announcement, Emma said that “2026 is a pivotal year for GSK” and “the right moment for new leadership”, emphasising her pride in leaving the company stronger and well prepared for “seamless succession”.  
Luke, currently Chief Commercial Officer, said he is “deeply honoured to be appointed” and “privileged to take on this responsibility”, highlighting GSK’s “outstanding prospects and enormous capacity to impact people’s health”.  
His vision is to lead a new phase of expansion, tasked with delivering GSK’s goal of more than £40bn (US$53.25) in sales by 2031.
## Leading client-focused innovation  
[James Addington-Smith](https://businesschief.com/news/how-marsh-uk-new-ceo-will-lead-client-focused-innovation) will become CEO of Marsh UK, succeeding Chris Lay, who is retiring after more than 40 years with the company.  
James, currently President of Marsh Asia, is tasked with leading the UK commercial strategy and delivering what Marsh calls “market-leading capabilities across risk, strategy and people”.  
President and CEO Martin South praised him in November as “an exceptional leader with a proven track record of client-focused innovation”.  
The new CEO said at the time it’s “an honour to return home” at a time when clients face volatility and new technologies, adding that he’s excited “to deliver the innovative services and solutions that enable our clients and their communities to thrive”.  
His appointment aligns with Marsh’s broader shift toward a unified brand and AI-driven transformation.
